snippet.title: Lambslide: Demo OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Download our demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226570/Lambslide/

Join our Discord when playtesting the demo & find a your yodelling buddies: https://discord.gg/d9nT8HgTvT

A cooperative, multiplayer, physics based, sheep herding game set on one very large alpine mountain. Get the flock down the mountain! Soon to be live at steam next fest!

Call em in. Scare em off. Carry em over. Chase em down.

You have no dog. But you have a hand puppet of one, and the sheep can't tell the difference. The flock is up there, it needs to be down here, and nobody is coming to help.


TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@lambslidegame?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc
